title: How lateralized different brain functions actually are (percent dominant side)

source.name: Functional lateralization studies (language dominance via fMRI/Wada testing; hemispheric specialization literature)
source.publisher: Peer-reviewed neuroscience research (e.g. Knecht et al., 'Handedness and hemispheric language dominance in healthy humans', Brain, 2000)

notes: Language is strongly left-lateralized in right-handed people (~96% per fMRI/Wada studies). Spatial attention shows a real but weaker right-hemisphere lean. 'Overall personality type' is marked at 50 (no measurable lateralization) to reflect the 2013 University of Utah finding that no whole-brain network dominance correlates with personality/thinking style -- Illustrative placement for that comparison point.
